git_commit_amended: Success toast after amending the last commit.
git_commit_conflicted_files: Count next to the merge or rebase in progress banner of the Source Control panel.
git_commit_discard_title: Confirm dialog title when discarding one file in the Source Control panel.
git_commit_discard_tracked: Confirm dialog body when discarding changes of a tracked file.
git_commit_discard_untracked: Confirm dialog body when discarding an untracked file.
git_commit_error_all_secret: Error under the commit box. Rust code commit_msg.all_secret.
git_commit_error_empty: Error under the commit box. Rust code commit_msg.empty_message.
git_commit_error_no_changes: Error under the commit box. Rust code commit_msg.no_changes.
git_commit_error_off: Error under the commit box. Rust code commit_msg.provider_off.
git_commit_error_ssh: Error under the commit box. Rust code commit_msg.ssh_host.
git_commit_force_push_body: Confirm dialog body of Force push with lease.
git_commit_force_push_confirm: Confirm button of the force push dialog.
git_commit_force_push_title: Confirm dialog title of the Force push with lease menu item in the Source Control panel.
git_commit_generate: Button of the commit box: an agent writes the commit message.
git_commit_group_changes: Group header in the Source Control file list: tracked files with unstaged changes.
git_commit_group_conflicts: Group header in the Source Control file list.
git_commit_group_staged: Group header in the Source Control file list.
git_commit_group_untracked: Group header in the Source Control file list: files git does not track yet.
git_commit_message_placeholder: Placeholder of the commit message box. {key} is the commit shortcut.
git_commit_notice_all: Line under the commit box when the AI commit message was written from all changes because nothing was staged.
git_commit_notice_all_with: Same line plus what was not sent in full. {omitted} is a list of the parts above.
git_commit_notice_cut: One part of the line under the commit box: diffs cut short before they went to the AI commit message provider.
git_commit_notice_left_out: One part of the line under the commit box: files left out of the AI commit message request because they are too large.
git_commit_notice_named_only: One part of the line under the commit box: lockfiles and binaries sent to the AI commit message provider by name only.
git_commit_notice_withheld: One part of the line under the commit box saying what the AI commit message provider did not get: files withheld because they may hold secrets.
git_commit_operation_merge: Banner of the Source Control panel while a merge is unfinished. The producer is git_review::operation (Rust).
git_commit_operation_rebase: Banner of the Source Control panel while a rebase is unfinished. The producer is git_review::operation (Rust).
git_commit_pick_agent: Info toast when Generate is pressed and no agent writes commit messages; Settings opens on the Git page.
git_commit_primary_commit: Main button of the commit box when something is staged.
git_commit_primary_pull: Main button of the commit box when the branch is behind its upstream. {count} is how many commits.
git_commit_primary_push_count: Main button of the commit box when the branch is ahead of its upstream. {count} is how many commits.
git_commit_primary_up_to_date: Disabled main button of the commit box when there is nothing to stage, commit, pull or push.
git_commit_regenerate: Button of the commit box when a generated message exists.
git_commit_save_amend: Submit button of the commit identity form when amending the last commit.
git_commit_save_commit: Submit button of the commit identity form.
git_commit_write_from_all: Tooltip of the Generate button when nothing is staged.
git_commit_write_from_staged: Tooltip of the Generate button when something is staged.
git_commit_write_message: Error toast when Commit is pressed with an empty message.
git_commit_writing: Status under the commit box while an agent writes the message, before its name is known.
git_commit_writing_with: Status under the commit box while an agent writes the message. {agent} is the agent's name. i18n-allow glossary:agent
